impacts.reason: The precondition that noCapLimit is intended per quote token, and the explicit intents that noCapLimit must reflect quote-token policy and be consistent across markets sharing a quote token, directly concern inconsistent mint/redeem limits.
The intent that noCapLimit must reflect the default policy based on the market's quote token directly concerns admins' ability to enforce centralized per-quote-token policy.
The explicit intents that noCapLimit must follow quote-token policy and be consistent across same-quote markets directly concern markets being too loose and bypassing mint caps.
The explicit intents that noCapLimit must reflect quote-token policy and be consistent across same-quote markets directly concern markets being too tight and failing to serve users.
The intents that noCapLimit must follow quote-token policy and be consistent regardless of base token directly concern users choosing base tokens to obtain higher noCapLimits.
The intents that noCapLimit must reflect quote-token policy and be consistent across same-quote markets directly concern minting large liquidity when it should be restricted.
